'''Chapter 1034''' is titled "Sanji vs. Queen".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "[[Usopp]] winning prizes for the children at the festival shooting game." by PN Ebi.

==Short Summary==
[[Queen]] reveals he possesses the same special superhuman abilities as [[Sanji]]'s three brothers, and after demonstrating them, he then activates Sanji's intended power of invisibility. As this happens, the oiran [[Some|O-Some]], whom Sanji believed he had struck earlier, enters the area, and Queen moves to attack her for rejecting his advances. Realizing that Queen was actually the one who struck O-Some, Sanji attacks the All-Star with ''[[Black Leg Style/Ifrit Jambe|Ifrit Jambe]]'', which he makes hotter than ever before using his newly modified body, and barrages him with devastating kicks.

==Long Summary==
In the Left Brain Tower Pleasure Hall, the various geishas try to escape the battle between [[Sanji]] and [[Queen]], except for the one who got hurt, [[Some|O-Some]], who has been looking for her pet mouse [[Chuji]]. Her colleagues tell her to prioritize herself and that they need to escape [[Onigashima]], possibly even [[Wano Country|Wano]] itself. Meanwhile, [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] manages to grab hold of [[Kaidou]]'s flame clouds and decides that if he cannot push the island back, he can at least pull it away from the [[Flower Capital]].

On the Live Floor, the samurai keep the [[Beasts Pirates]] from escaping, and in the Pleasure Hall, Queen unleashes an attack called '''[[Queen#Techniques|Sparking Queen]]''', and fires lasers from his eyes at Sanji, who jumps into the air to avoid. He realizes Queen's attack mimics [[Vinsmoke Ichiji|Ichiji]]'s '''Sparking Valkyrie''', and then Queen uses an attack called '''Henry Queen''', where he extends his mechanical neck at Sanji and grabs him with his mouth and badly electrocutes him, he sees it mimics [[Vinsmoke Niji|Niji]]'s '''Henry Blazer'''. As a hurt Sanji falls to the ground, Queen fires more lasers as he tries to dodge them all, Queen reveals that he wanted to show Sanji that he could replicate [[Germa 66]]'s abilities after he put on the [[Raid Suit]], and declares [[Vinsmoke Judge|Judge]]'s children to be the culmination of his scientific work. He also reveals to Sanji that he had desired to defeat Sanji while he wore the Raid Suit simply so he could prove to Judge that he was the superior mind, which annoys Sanji that he would force his feud with Judge onto him.

Queen then grabs Sanji with his mechanical claw and, similar to how [[Vinsmoke Yonji|Yonji]] uses '''Winch Danton''', swings Sanji around with '''Winch Queen''', causing great damage to Sanji by smashing him through walls and making him bleed. Eventually though, Sanji quickly destroys Queen's mechanical arm with a kick, thereby freeing him from his grip. As Queen recoils in anger, Sanji reminds him to not bring up his family in front of him before striking him with '''Diable Jambe: Flanchet Strike''', which causes Queen to fall to his knees in pain. Sanji tells Queen that there is no way he did not feel his kick from before, and as this fight has long progressed, the both of them have been getting weaker and weaker throughout it all. Sanji, however, tells him that he found his resolve and accepted his fate, and that he is not the same person he was on the Live Floor.

Queen tells Sanji to show him that as he reveals that he can too turn invisible like Sanji's Raid Suit. Sanji admits Queen has a lot of tricks before vanishing again, and Queen realizes that Sanji is not turning invisible, but moving faster than the eye can see. Queen expects Sanji to reappear when he runs out of stamina just as O-Some finally finds Chuji. Queen sees her and reveals that he made her his "number one" after [[Kouzuki Hiyori|Komurasaki]]'s apparent death, and he remembers that she had rejected his summons multiple times, even today by claiming she had a migraine. As he walks up to her while invisible, he declares that he will distribute more "divine punishment" to her.

Sanji, meanwhile, while in the air, realizes he has more tools at his disposal. By combining his exoskeleton with his [[Haki/Armament Haki|Armament Haki]], he creates flames on his legs hotter than before, dubbing it as '''[[Black Leg Style/Ifrit Jambe|Ifrit Jambe]]'''. As he makes his way towards Queen, he comes to the realization that the one who hurt O-Some in that moment was Queen when he was invisible. Filled with rage, Sanji attacks Queen with '''Collier''', slamming his head into the ground and making himself visible again, which O-Some sees. Sanji follows up with '''Basse Côte''', and then '''Paleron''', '''Jumeau à Bifteck''', '''Tendron''', '''Flanchet''', '''Queue''', '''Poire''', '''Jarret''', and finally, '''Bœuf Burst''', causing a huge explosion and sending Queen flying backwards.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] continues pulling [[Onigashima]] away.
*The [[samurai]] and [[Beasts Pirates]] continue to fight each other.
*The fight between [[Sanji]] and [[Queen]] continues:
**Queen's [[Cyborgs|cyborg]] body is able to mimic the abilities of the [[Raid Suit|raid suits]] of the [[Vinsmoke Family|Vinsmoke brothers]].
**Queen realizes that Sanji cannot turn invisible, instead Sanji moves so fast to make it look like he disappeared.
**Sanji breaks Queen's mechanical left arm.
**Sanji saves [[Some|O-Some]], the girl he allegedly hurt before, from being attacked by an invisible Queen.
***It is revealed Queen was the one who attacked O-Some earlier, due to her refusing his service after he became obsessed with her, following [[Kouzuki Hiyori|Komurasaki]]'s "death".
**With his awakened [[Modified Humans|enhancement]], Sanji unveils a powerful new ability, [[Black Leg Style/Ifrit Jambe|Ifrit Jambe]], and unleashes a chain of devastating attacks on Queen which greatly wound Queen and sends him flying away.
